# JoinOrder Q3b — Canonical JoinOrder 3b

> [JoinOrder](../../join-order.md) benchmark · [all JoinOrder queries](index.md)

Canonical JoinOrder SQL query 3b; generated DataFrame translation

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT MIN(t.title) AS movie_title
FROM keyword AS k,
     movie_info AS mi,
     movie_keyword AS mk,
     title AS t
WHERE k.keyword LIKE '%sequel%'
  AND mi.info IN ('Bulgaria')
  AND t.production_year > 2010
  AND t.id = mi.movie_id
  AND t.id = mk.movie_id
  AND mk.movie_id = mi.movie_id
  AND k.id = mk.keyword_id;
```
